first.rationale: Onboarding completion (-4%) is upstream of activation (-6%), so a single fix at the onboarding step plausibly relieves both symptoms, whereas activation messaging treats only the downstream one. The competitor's entry pricing makes promotional_pricing the emotionally obvious move, but discounting responds to a price war on the competitor's terms and directly threatens the primary objective of SUSTAINABLE qualified revenue; its supporting evidence (memory_73) also carries an explicit methodological caveat (two cohorts pooled after a mid-test redefinition), so its measured lift may be partly artifact. Referral incentives (memory_57) target established customers, not the leaking self-serve funnel, and enterprise_sales_assist (memory_44) addresses a segment that is not the source of the current decline. I am spending verification on memory_31 because it is the single memory my intended action rests on most directly and it is the oldest (day 12) — a durable lift measured 64 days ago under different competitive conditions may not survive; I want the original record's definition of 'activation' and whether the lift was ever re-measured. I am spending the second pull on memory_73 not because I intend to act on it but because it is the flagged one and the tempting one: if the pooled-cohort issue inflated the result, that removes pricing from contention cleanly; if the record shows a genuine effect in a clean cohort, I should reconsider even at cost to margin. Downstream value risk is real and flagged: memory_31's mechanism is cutting required signup fields, which can raise raw activation counts while degrading lead qualification and routing — exactly the metric-improves/value-degrades pattern. I will not treat activation lift as success on its own; the experiment needs guardrails on downstream lead quality, sales-accepted rate, and 60-90 day retained revenue, not just first-week activation. Inherited memories are summaries of past conditions, not current facts; the recent QoQ declines are themselves evidence that the environment has shifted since these were consolidated, so I hold all of them as provisional pending the two pulls.
